_note: Chris's overrides. A gloss listed here wins over everything the pipeline works out for itself: the sense search, the verified corrections and the default Signbank entry. Use it when the pipeline picked a sign you do not teach.
_how: Give the exact file already in assets/auslan_signs/ (for example "WHO_2.gif"), or the bare variant name without an extension ("WHO_2"). To bring in a sign that is not in the bank yet, add its Signbank entry URL to the unit's links file and refetch with --gif --links, then name the file here.
